test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a parameter used to calculate Human Development Index?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Environment around the living area.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Life Expectancy**, **Expected years of schooling **and **Gross National Income per capita** are the parameter used to calculate Human Development Index.
 
• Human Development Index is the statistical tool used to measure a country's overall achievement in** social and economic dimensions**.
 
• The social and economic dimensions of a country are based on the health of people, their level of educational attainment and their standard of living.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The human development Index(HDI) was developed by Pakistani economist Mahbub ul Haq and was further used to measure a country's development by the **United Nations Development Programme's Human Development Report Office.**
 
• **United Nation Development Programme (UNDP)** released Human development Index.
